infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Auralink records your voice while you hold its shortcut and sends the audio to the speech service you set up. 录音只在你按下快捷键时进行，并发送给你配置的语音识别服务。
infoPlist.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Auralink reads the address of the browser tab in front to pick the scene rules you set for that site. The address is never sent to a model. Auralink 读取当前浏览器标签页的网址，用来匹配你为该网站设置的场景规则；网址不会发送给模型。
